topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light waves act like ripples in a pond.
Coherence means stable, rhythmic wave relationships.
Laser beams create perfectly rhythmic waves.

sections.title: The Phenomenon of Diffraction
lecture_lines: Diffraction is light bending around obstacles.
Light waves overlap to form interference patterns.
Interference patterns map intensity peaks and troughs.
animations: Show obstacle with small gap, color #8A2BE2.
Propagate plane waves towards gap, color #00FF7F.
Illustrate diffraction pattern after gap, color #FFD700.

sections.title: The Holographic Recording Process
lecture_lines: Reference beams provide the stable baseline.
Object beams carry scattered phase information.
Recording combines them into interference patterns.
Holograms freeze this grid on film.
The pattern stores complete wave geometry.
animations: Display reference beam and object beam using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg], color #00BFFF.
Show interference on holographic plate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/film.svg], color #FF69B4.
Freeze final interference fringes on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/film.svg], color #32CD32.

sections.title: The Holographic Reconstruction
lecture_lines: Reference light hits the recorded pattern.
The film acts like a diffraction grating.
Light bends to recreate original wavefronts.
The object appears to float in space.
We have successfully reconstructed the 3D scene.
animations: Illuminate plate with reference beam using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg], color #00BFFF.
Show diffracted light forming object image, color #FFD700.
Highlight virtual image location with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hologram.svg], color #FF4500.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Holography is precise control of light diffraction.
We store complete light wave physics.
This transforms imaging and secure authentication.
